title: AV-8B Weapons Training Officer (WTO) Qualification (I) (Col to 2ndLt) NMOS (7509, 8042), DC AVN
raw_text:
22. MOS 7536, AV-8B Weapons Training Officer (WTO) Qualification (I) (Col to
2ndLt) NMOS (7509, 8042), DC AVN

    a. Summary. WTO personnel are subject matter experts and instructors in
the aircraft weapons, systems, sensors, threat countermeasures, and mission
planning tools. This MOS will be assigned only as a Necessary MOS to
qualified aviation personnel.

       b.   Prerequisites

            (1) Complete with IUT stage and requirements.

            (2) Nominated by squadron commanding officer.

            (3) Security requirement:     secret or higher security clearance.

            (4) Designated section leader in accordance with the AV-8B T&R
Manual.

            (5) Complete with all 2000 and 3000 level codes in the AV-8B T&R
Manual.

    c. Requirements. Complete the Weapons Training Officer (WTO) program in
accordance with the MAWTS-1 AV-8B Course Catalog.

    d. Duties. Upon meeting all eligibility listed for the certification of
this MOS, the individual recipient shall coordinate with their unit
administration department to ensure this MOS is added to their Official
Military Personnel File (OMPF) in order to accurately reflect the
corresponding aviation qualification/designation within their permanent
record.

    e.      Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and
Code.       Teachers and Instructors, All Other 25-3099.

       f.   Related Military Skill.     None.
